blocks.text: The second season of the reality series “LOL: Last One Laughing Philippines” is set to premiere on Oct. 30, with Vice Ganda returning as host. The upcoming edition will feature a new set of comedians that “[brings] together different generations, backgrounds and styles of Filipino comedy.” Included in the lineup are Long Mejia, Epy Quizon, Candy Pangilinan, Ethel Booba, Pooh, Donna Cariaga, Chariz Solomon, Esnyr, James Caraan and Charuth. In the show, the 10 comedians will be locked together for six hours and tasked with making their fellow contestants laugh without breaking character.
